cohort_scope.municipal: Public municipal rosters: 99 Jalisco and 51 Nuevo Leon; a geographic convenience cohort, not a national random sample.
cohort_scope.prior_notary_development: 60 reused prior notaries, including historical-report and comparator selection; used in previous fixes, never held out.
cohort_scope.new_notary: 90 additional CDMX notaries sampled from the public roster with seed 20261017; no independently complete incident reference.
cohort_scope.incident_truth: 30 persons had historical reported-incident labels and 270 remained unknown; 0 independently certified incident-free controls. Document-level neutral roles are valid negatives only for those publications.

annotations: Assistant-agent document review blind to individual predictions; no external human adjudication.

aggregate_status_exposure_disclosed.source: Unrequested collaboration message from live_runner reporting completion of warm1 archive
aggregate_status_exposure_disclosed.exposure: Aggregate production score/identity status counts, without entity IDs, document IDs, individual predictions, findings, score values or per-pair resolutions
aggregate_status_exposure_disclosed.action: Asked runner and parent to withhold further output statuses and predictions until all cuts' new document labels are locked
aggregate_status_exposure_disclosed.reporting_limit: Document role labels remain blind to individual pipeline outputs. Do not claim that the audit received no aggregate output information whatsoever before all future derived cuts were labelled.

selection_blinding_limits.status: method limitation disclosure; no label, sample or denominator change
blinding_established: No annotator has opened current NLP predictions, actual evidence analyses, identity resolutions, reviews or score outputs.
Explicit prior incident truth and selection_stratum values are not included in the reviewer packet.
blinding_not_established: Original entity identifiers include prefixes such as positive-, and target names or public roles can reveal historical selection or notoriety. Therefore group/incident-selection blindness is not complete despite omission of explicit label fields.
The annotators are assistant agents, not external human experts; no double-blind or legally certified ground truth is claimed.
The reused 60 notaries were used in earlier corrections and remain diagnostic, not held-out.
selection_blinding_limits.required_reporting: Describe annotations as prediction-blind assistant-agent document review. Do not call them fully blind, selection-blind or external human adjudication.

public_reporting_policy.stage: before individual persisted predictions are unsealed

quantitative_rules.retrieval_precision: Report known-truth precision together with unknown count and lower/upper relevance bounds; never claim sampled 100% known precision as full-population certainty.
quantitative_rules.role_detector: Observed counts and fixed-stratum inverse-inclusion-weighted estimates; unknown truth shown separately. Positive abstentions remain in recall denominator, all known-label abstentions penalize accuracy.
quantitative_rules.conditionality: NLP role metrics conditional on retrieved originals in each cut; they do not measure all-web retrieval, personal guilt or complete legal identity.
quantitative_rules.reference_recall: Use original pre-frozen known relevant reference denominator without provider/access exclusions. Exact URL and hash-revalidated archived redirect supplemental figures remain separate. Reused60 development diagnostics, new240 no complete reference.
quantitative_rules.identity_precision: No independent legal-identity target: report conservative workflow statuses/abstentions and reviewed relevance associations, not certified identity accuracy.
quantitative_rules.warm1: No probability estimate from a stale or absent projection; preserve rejected snapshot and operational/integrity diagnostics.
quantitative_rules.volume: Separate cumulative historical originals, current useful articles, multimedia references, entity coverage, newly acquired versus inherited originals, candidate metadata and actual network requests.
quantitative_rules.before_after: Different storage frames and providers imply different denominators; no causal or held-out claim.

public_reporting_policy.blinding_disclosure: Cold labels all locked before aggregate warm1 status message. Later labels are blind to individual predictions but auditor has seen aggregate completion/status counts; no external human adjudication.

runs.scope: Cold real acquisition: original 11 sources, 3300 planned canonical-name searches; no prior cache.

score_accuracy.reason: No independent external numerical or categorical score target; do not infer correctness from its own findings.

observed_detector.scope: Descriptive observed sample counts; not prevalence of all people or independent news stories.

stratified_population_detector_estimate.scope: Stratum-weighted estimates for the fixed pair sample; no binomial interval on fractional weights.

production_chain.meaning: Workflow coverage through eligibility and selection for a positive provisional component after conservative event/content deduplication. An unselected duplicate is not counted as a separate contribution. This is not accuracy of a numeric score or legal identity certification.

Accuracy and recall concern reported document roles among retrieved sampled originals, not person guilt or all-web search recall.
Repeated stories, shared URLs and geographic selection limit independence and generalization.
Finding detection is separate from verified identity, scoring eligibility and numerical score status.
